subject: general
question: Department of Health Research has organized___________ Campaign from 17th September 2024 to 2nd October 2024.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swachhata Hi Seva Campaign**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__
 __ 
• The **Swachhata Hi Seva Campaign** is a flagship initiative of the **Department of Health Research**, aligned with the **Swachh Bharat Mission**, to promote cleanliness and hygiene across India. 
• The campaign is scheduled from **17th September 2024 to 2nd October 2024**, coinciding with the **birth anniversary of Mahatma Gandhi**, a staunch advocate of cleanliness and sanitation. 
• It emphasizes **community participation** to drive activities such as cleanliness drives, waste removal, and awareness programs aimed at achieving a cleaner and healthier environment. 
• The campaign focuses on ensuring the active involvement of **citizens, schools, businesses, NGOs, and local bodies** to promote sustainable hygiene practices, particularly in urban and rural areas. 
• This initiative is part of the larger **Swachh Bharat Mission**, which was launched on **2nd October 2014** by Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** to achieve universal sanitation coverage and eliminate open defecation in India. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **Swachh Bharat Mission:** 
• The **Swachh Bharat Mission** was launched on **2nd October 2014** to honor Mahatma Gandhi’s vision of cleanliness and sanitation. 
• The mission comprises two components: **Swachh Bharat Mission (Urban)** and **Swachh Bharat Mission (Rural)**. 
• As of today, the mission has led to the construction of **over 100 million toilets** across India, significantly reducing open defecation. 
• It also emphasizes waste management through methods like **solid waste management** and **door-to-door waste collection**. 
• **Mahatma Gandhi's Role in Cleanliness Advocacy:** 
• **Mahatma Gandhi** consistently advocated for the importance of cleanliness, considering it equally important as independence. 
• He often emphasized that a clean environment is essential for building a healthy and progressive society. 
• His teachings continue to inspire modern initiatives like the Swachh Bharat Mission and the **Swachhata Hi Seva Campaign**. 
• **Plastic-Free India Campaign:** 
• The Plastic-Free India Campaign aims to eliminate the use of **single-use plastics** to combat environmental pollution. 
• It promotes the adoption of sustainable and eco-friendly alternatives to reduce the environmental impact of plastic waste. 
• **Namami Gange Program:** 
• The **Namami Gange Program** is a flagship initiative by the Government of India to clean and rejuvenate the **Ganga River**. 
• It integrates efforts to address issues such as water pollution, waste management, and biodiversity conservation. 
• **Impact of the Swachhata Hi Seva Campaign:** 
• Contributes to reducing the prevalence of diseases such as **diarrhea** and **cholera** caused by unhygienic conditions. 
• Improves the quality of life, especially for **women and children**. 
• Promotes sustainable waste management practices like **recycling** and **composting**. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• **Government Support:** 
• The government provides **financial assistance** to urban and rural areas for constructing toilets and waste management systems. 
• Educational campaigns are organized to spread awareness about the importance of **cleanliness and hygiene**. 
• Digital platforms monitor and report the progress of cleanliness initiatives under this campaign. 
• **Community Involvement:** 
• Local bodies, schools, and NGOs are encouraged to actively participate in cleanliness drives. 
• Competitions, workshops, and rallies are organized to engage citizens in promoting hygiene practices.
